title: Cockell Aviation completes acquisition of SIL Industries
summary: The acquisition brings together two organizations with a shared commitment to quality, reliability and customer service.
body_markdown:
SIL Industries Photo


Cockell Aviation today announced that it has successfully completed its purchase of SIL Industries. The acquisition brings together two organizations with a shared commitment to quality, reliability and customer service, and marks the beginning of an exciting new chapter for both companies.


Over many years, SIL Industries has earned a reputation for dependable work, technical expertise and genuine care for its customers. Cockell Aviation is committed to honouring and continuing that legacy. The SIL name, its people and the standards customers have come to rely on will remain at the heart of the business.


With the added resources and support of Cockell Aviation, SIL Industries is well positioned for its next stage of growth.


Cockell Aviation plans to invest in SIL’s capabilities, expand its reach, and create new opportunities for its team while maintaining the quality that defines the SIL brand.


Above all, both companies share a focus on people. Cockell Aviation is dedicated to building strong, lasting relationships with SIL’s existing customers, and to welcoming new customers with the same level of service, trust and responsiveness they have come to expect.


“We are thrilled to be able to work with the team at SIL as this next chapter of both companies begins,” said Harry Cockell, director of Cockell Aviation. “Thank you to their ownership and management for the hard work, and to the exciting opportunities for both companies ahead.”


“Customers, suppliers and partners can expect a smooth transition, with day-to-day operations continuing as usual. Further updates will be shared as the two companies begin working together,” said Roy Schellekens, ex-president of SIL Industries.
